hazards.name: Poison Emitter
hazards.text: This space kills one of each Pikmin type that passes it that isn't immune to poison.\nDisappears when it loses 5 health. It loses one health every turn.

hazards.name: Electricity Generator
hazards.text: This space can only be passed by Pikmin immune to electricity.\n\nIt is discarded when it takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Fire Geyser
hazards.text: This space can only be passed by Pikmin immune to fire.\n\nIt is discarded when it takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Water Spout
hazards.text: This space can only be passed by Pikmin immune to water.\n\nIt is discarded when it takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Ice Vent
hazards.text: This space can only be passed by Pikmin immune to ice.\n\nIt is discarded when it takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Wall
hazards.text: This space is blocked.\n\nPikmin cannot pass until this card takes 10 damage.

hazards.name: Webbed Wall
hazards.text: Winged Pikmin cannot pass or destroy this hazard. Pikmin cannot carry treasure through this hazard.\n\nIt is discarded when it takes 10 damage.

hazards.name: Crystal Wall
hazards.text: This space is blocked and can only be destroyed by Rock Pikmin.\n\nPikmin cannot pass until this card takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Electric Wall
hazards.text: This space is blocked and can only be destroyed by Yellow Pikmin.\n\nPikmin cannot pass until this card takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Ice Wall
hazards.text: This space is blocked and can only be destroyed by Ice Pikmin.\n\nPikmin cannot pass until this card takes 5 damage.

hazards.name: Bridge
hazards.text: Until this space takes 20 damage, it has no hazard.\n\nThis is destroyed when a Treasure Pile is carried over it.

hazards.name: Climbing Stick
hazards.text: This can only be placed on height spaces.\n\nThis space has no hazard.

hazards.name: Tunnel
hazards.text:
This can only be placed on chasm spaces.

This space has no hazard for pikmin.
Treasures cannot pass this.
